description: Access permissions, entitlements, and authorizations are not defined in policy.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Identity and access management teams Security awareness and training programs Organizations managing user authentication

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify systems where access control policies are absent, not documented, or not enforced, including lack of formal authorization procedures, missing implementation of least privilege principles, inadequate separation of duties, or absence of regular access reviews and recertification processes.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls
